final.summary: Flows balance from intake through the ETP to the outfall with no missing water, and power followed the inflow load. Outfall pH stayed near neutral and conductivity stayed in its normal range, with no sign of raw wastewater or added groundwater.

explanations.label: Normal operation: batch wastewater treated through working ETP
Bypass: untreated wastewater sent around ETP to outfall
Aeration cut: ETP inflow passed but blowers/power cut
Dilution: groundwater added to outfall to mask discharge
Meter fault: one or more feeds unreliable for the stretch

key_evidence.why: All balances within tolerance with no unaccounted water, showing flow went through ETP to outfall.
Power matched expected band for inflow with zero share below band, showing aeration followed load.
Outfall pH stayed near neutral with max below 9, showing no raw alkaline water reached outfall.
Conductivity stayed in normal range with no drop, showing no groundwater dilution.
Power feed not replayed, so power evidence can be relied on.

final.scope_line: Based on flow, power, pH and conductivity records for 2026-10-13 18:00 to 2026-10-14 22:00. Does not measure every pollutant.
limitations: No lab BOD result covers the interval, so organic pollutant removal is inferred from power and flow, not directly measured.
Logbook entries are factory claims, not physical evidence, and were tested against signals.
Power confirms flow only roughly because the expected band is wide; a small meter error could still sit inside it.

steps.why: Water balance separates normal operation from bypass or dilution by accounting for tank storage versus inflow and outfall.

result.note: ETP balance: treated flow reaching the outfall vs outfall flow (same time). Boundary balance: intake vs outfall + losses + sludge water + tank storage change (reuse cancels). Tank balance: wastewater arriving (estimated from intake) vs ETP inflow + storage change; unaccounted water left the tank another way, or was intake water that never became wastewater. null means a required signal is under 80% coverage.

steps.why: Power versus inflow separates aeration cut from normal operation when inflow is normal.

result.note: Expected band fitted on the factory's normal-operation baseline from ETP inflow; with the ETP off, expected is standby power.

steps.why: Outfall pH above 9 would show untreated water reaching outfall and separate bypass from normal treatment.
